propositions: Self-contained HTTP MCP server must be deployed on AWS box with nginx /mcp/ TLS edge routing to loopback-bound rebar-mcp using static bearer token authentication
Blue-green immutable-release autodeploy mechanism must replace review-bot drain pattern to avoid saturation and enable atomic upstream flip without killing in-flight MCP operations
MCP server must sign certified ops (plan-review and completion-verifier) under existing opcert environment 9f1c8e42 and integrate with verify.require_environment enforcement mechanism
Per-client bearer PATs for copilot, codex, and claude must be provisioned via SSM parameters and stored in gitignored local config template
Documentation must be updated to specify MCP is required for all rebar ops except local-code operations and clarify that code-review remains Gerrit LLM-Review vote not op-cert
Three client tools must successfully execute basic read commands against live MCP endpoint as verification of end-to-end integration
